# faBolusGarmin — LLM guide

> Garmin (Connect IQ / Monkey C) remote for faBolus. Thin remote: it relays confirmed bolus / cancel /
> dismiss requests to the iPhone host over Connect IQ. The phone owns the pump. Experimental, not
> FDA-cleared.

Thin map so it does not drift. Working guide: [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md).

- **`README.md`** — how it fits together, the venu3s device floor, build and test.
- **`docs/BUILDING.md`** — the one build: sideload, a private beta, and the release binary.
- **`docs/SECURITY.md`** — remote-bolus notes. The watch gesture is one confirmation, not one of two.
- Contract: protocol version 2, vendored in `contract/` from faBolus at `contract/PIN`. Update with
  `scripts/sync-contract.sh`; `scripts/check-contract.sh` verifies the copy.

No direct-to-pump or direct-to-CGM engine. Sibling protocol repo is `../TandemKit`.
The phone is the authority; note anything unverified on-hardware.
